## Appearance

Ezra possesses a large, gangly frame highlighted by noticeably elongated legs. He has limp, flaxen hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and a voice that is described as delightful.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Ezra P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 ch.Ezra P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011)_

## History

Ezra studied theology at St. [Columbia](../codex/places.md#columbia), having graduated from [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) and spent years attempting to avoid becoming a clergyman. Over the summer, he took responsibility for the Point Prospect Mission Church while staying at a boardinghouse, where he developed a romance with [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md). Ezra eventually proposed to [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), and she accepted his offer of marriage.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Ezra P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Ezra P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Ezra P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Ezra P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 ch.Ezra P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 ch.Ezra P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), +4 more_

## Relationships

### [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cressy-lindsay--ezra.md)

Ezra is an earnest young theology student whom [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) meets while staying at a boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) develops a deep admiration and romantic devotion to Ezra, eventually accepting his marriage proposal during a walk in the park. The pair become engaged, with plans to be married in June.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Ezra P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Ezra P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Ezra P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), +14 more_

- Romantically involved with — fiancé  <sub>[v3 ch.Rowena P9](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0009), [v3 ch.Rowena P11](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0011), [v3 ch.Opens P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>
- presumed Spouse of — fiancé to be married in June  <sub>[v3 ch.Wedding P6](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0006), [v3 ch.Dawn P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005)</sub>

### [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ezra--honora-hollis.md)

[Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) is an elderly boarder who lives at the [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) boardinghouse alongside Ezra. Unlike several of the other older women residing there, [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) approves of the young theology student and does not join in their disapproval of him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Ezra P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Ezra P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Ezra P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), +2 more_

- Friend of — approves of him and does not join the other elderly women in disapproving of him  <sub>[v3 ch.Ezra P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
